# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_SLOPE_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
When price pulls back to VWAP while the EMA ribbon is steeply sloped upward, the trend is likely to resume. This captures the edge of buying the dip in a strong uptrend, where the VWAP acts as dynamic support and the ribbon slope confirms trend strength.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: Price crosses below VWAP by ≤0.1% and then closes above VWAP on the same 1‑min bar while the 5‑EMA > 10‑EMA > 20‑EMA ribbon slope (5‑EMA minus 20‑EMA) is >0.05% of price and rising for two consecutive bars.
Exit shape: Chart-stop at recent swing low (prior HH/HL invalidation), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail 20% off HWM.
Regime hint: Works best when VIX < 18 and time between 09:45‑11:30 EST; avoid choppy sessions where ribbon is flat.
